p.i: Aul. 3. 3. v. 20. Lege agito mecum, molestus ne sis.

main_text.p: AD Prætorem ducere, & in jus vocare, licebat: rapere non licebat, nisi ei qui antestatus esset. Itaq; perturbatus Euclio sic alloquitur adolescentem Aul. 4. 10. v. 30.

p.i: Jam quidem hercle ad Prætorem te rapiam, & tibi scribam dicam.

main_text.p: IN judicijs dies actus constituebatur causis agendis, qui status dicebatur.

p.i: Si status conditus cum hoste intercedit dies.

main_text.p: JUDICUM & Prætorum est sedere: co quod judex animo constante, sedato, & bene composito esse debet.

p.i: Modo vos ijdem in A. Gabinium judices sedistis.
Quod si modo judices, de causa ista sederent. C. Fabricium, Cn. Pompejum,

main_text.p: PRÆTOR in privatis controversijs, quacumq; de re ageretur, da-bant

page.notes: The small ornament after "constituebatur" and the mark beside "dicebatur" are not text. Catchword "bant" is printed at the foot right; it is recorded as the last word of the text. Marginal left-edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and were omitted.
